s.note: Toasted sourdough under a grilled sauce of sharp cheddar, mustard, milk and egg yolk, with cayenne and spring onion
s.how: Melt 30g butter in a pan, stir in 2 tbsp flour for a minute, then whisk in 150ml milk until thick. Off the heat stir in 250g grated sharp cheddar, 2 tsp English mustard, 1 egg yolk, a pinch of cayenne and black pepper. Toast 8 thick slices of sourdough on one side under the grill, turn, spread thickly with the cheese mixture right to the edges and grill for 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling and blistered. Scatter with sliced spring onion and serve hot.

s.note: Parsi fried chicken marinated in ginger, garlic, chilli and spice, crumbed in semolina and egg, with lemon and mango chutney
s.how: Mix 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste, the juice of half a lemon, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala and 1 tsp salt and rub into 1kg chicken drumettes and wings. Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Roll each piece in a mix of 60g fine semolina and 60g breadcrumbs, dip in 3 beaten eggs and roll again. Shallow-fry in 2cm of oil at 170C for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through. Drain and serve with lemon wedges and mango chutney.

m.n: Parsi family lamb dhansak with brown rice
m.note: Lamb simmered in a spiced dal of lentils, pumpkin, eggplant and tamarind, with caramelised onion brown rice and kachumber
m.how: Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder in 2 tbsp ghee and lift out. Fry 1 chopped onion until golden, add 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste, 2 slit green chillies, 2 tbsp dhansak masala and 1 tsp cumin for 2 minutes. Return the lamb with 1 cup toor dal, 1/2 cup red lentils, 300g diced pumpkin, 1 diced eggplant, 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp turmeric and 1.5 litres water. Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours until the lamb is soft. Lift out the lamb, blend the dal roughly, then return the lamb with 1 tbsp tamarind, 1 tbsp brown sugar and salt and simmer 10 minutes. For the rice, fry 1 sliced onion in 2 tbsp ghee until deep brown, add 1 tbsp sugar to caramelise, then a cinnamon stick, 2 cups rinsed basmati, salt and 3 cups water. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes and rest 5. Toss red onion, cucumber and tomato with lime for the kachumber. Serve the dhansak with coriander, the rice and the kachumber.

w.note: Parsi wedding custard of reduced milk, condensed milk, eggs, cardamom and nutmeg, baked golden under flaked almonds
w.how: Simmer 1 litre full cream milk in a wide pan, stirring often, for 25 minutes until reduced by about a third. Stir in a 395g tin condensed milk and cool for 15 minutes. Heat the oven to 160C. Whisk in 4 eggs, 1/2 tsp ground cardamom, a good grating of nutmeg and 1 tsp vanilla, then strain into a buttered 20cm baking dish. Scatter with 40g flaked almonds and bake in a water bath for 45 minutes until just set and golden on top. Serve warm or cold.

d.note: Cold lager topped half and half with lemonade, with a lemon wedge, in a chilled pint glass
d.how: Chill 4 pint glasses. Half fill each with cold lager, tilting the glass, then top up with cold lemonade and drop in a lemon wedge.

shopping: 2 tbsp dhansak masala or garam masala@Spices
